from enum import Enum from itertools import chain import polars as pl from great_tables import GT, html, loc, style, system_fonts from polars import selectors as cs # The book reads the data as CSV (the JSON of Polars 0.20 is not read by Polars 1) # and the logos from the entry's repository. csv_file = "../data/contest/euroncap_2023.csv" logo_path = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jrycw/posit-gt-2024/master/logo/" logo_pngs = ["bmw", "hyundai", "kia", "smart", "vinfast", "xpeng"] adult_occupant_columns = ["Frontal Impact", "Lateral Impact", "Rear Impact", "Rescue and Extrication"] child_occupant_columns = ["Crash Test Performance", "Safety Features", "CRS Installation Check"] vulnerable_road_users_columns = ["VRU Impact Protection", "VRU Impact Mitigation"] safety_assist_columns = ["Speed Assistance", "Occupant Status Monitoring", "Lane Support", "AEB Car-to-Car"] testing_columns = ( adult_occupant_columns + child_occupant_columns + vulnerable_road_users_columns + safety_assist_columns ) testing_groups = ( adult_occupant_columns, child_occupant_columns, vulnerable_road_users_columns, safety_assist_columns, ) testing_group_names = ("adult", "child", "vru", "assist") testing_columns_with_rank = [] for _grp, _grp_name in zip(testing_groups, testing_group_names): testing_columns_with_rank.extend(chain(_grp, [_grp_name])) def tweak_df(csv_file: str) -> pl.DataFrame: df = pl.read_csv(csv_file, schema_overrides={"Stars": pl.Utf8}) _make = pl.col("Make").str.to_lowercase() make = ( pl.when(_make.is_in(logo_pngs)) .then(_make.add(".png")) .otherwise(_make.add(".jpg")) ) model = pl.concat_str(pl.lit("["), pl.col("Model"), pl.lit("]("), pl.col("Url"), pl.lit(")")).alias("Model") stars = pl.col("Stars").add("⭐") grps = ( pl.sum_horizontal(grp).alias(grp_name) for grp, grp_name in zip(testing_groups, testing_group_names) ) sub_ranks = ( pl.col(grp_name).rank("min", descending=True).cast(pl.UInt8) for grp_name in testing_group_names ) rank = ( pl.mean_horizontal(testing_group_names) .rank("min", descending=False) .cast(pl.UInt8) .alias("Rank") ) return ( df.with_columns(pl.col(testing_columns).cast(pl.Float64)) .with_columns(model, make, stars, *grps) .with_columns(sub_ranks) .with_columns(rank) .sort( "Class", "Rank", *testing_group_names, descending=[True, False] + [False] * len(testing_group_names), ) .select(chain(("Class", "Model", "Make", "Stars", "Rank"), testing_columns_with_rank)) ) df = tweak_df(csv_file) class EuroNCAPPalette(str, Enum): TABLE_BACKGROUND: str = "#F5F5F5" STUB_COLUMN_LABEL: str = "#D4E6A8" ROW_GROUP: str = "#BFE2A7" CELL: str = "#F4FAF1" HIGHLIGHT1: str = "#C0DA80" TITLE: str = "#30937B" GRADIENT1: str = "#E7CE91" GRADIENT2: str = "#F2E4C0" GRADIENT3: str = "#F5EFE7" domain_nominal_max = { "Frontal Impact": 16, "Lateral Impact": 16, "Rear Impact": 4, "Rescue and Extrication": 4, "Crash Test Performance": 24, "Safety Features": 13, "CRS Installation Check": 12, "VRU Impact Protection": 36, "VRU Impact Mitigation": 27, "Speed Assistance": 3, "Occupant Status Monitoring": 3, "Lane Support": 3, "AEB Car-to-Car": 9, } top_scores = {"adult": 40, "child": 49, "vru": 63, "assist": 18} short_names = { "Frontal Impact": "Frontal

({domain_nominal_max[col]}/{top_scores[name]})") for grp, name in zip(testing_groups, testing_group_names) for col in grp } def a_html(text: str, url: str) -> html: return html(f'{text}') explained = "https://www.euroncap.com/en/car-safety/the-ratings-explained/" spanners = ( a_html("Adult Occupant", explained + "adult-occupant-protection/"), a_html("Child Occupant", explained + "child-occupant-protection/"), a_html("Vulnerable Road Users", explained + "vulnerable-road-user-vru-protection/"), a_html("Safety Assist", explained + "safety-assist/"), ) gtbl = ( GT(df, groupname_col="Class", rowname_col="Model") .fmt_image("Make", path=logo_path) .fmt_number(columns=testing_columns, decimals=1) .fmt_markdown(columns=["Model"]) .cols_width(dict.fromkeys(testing_columns, "60px") | dict.fromkeys(testing_group_names, "30px")) .cols_align(align="center", columns=["Make", "Stars"]) .cols_align(align="right", columns=["Rank", *testing_group_names]) .cols_label( **{"Rank": html("Rank1")} | testing_labels | dict.fromkeys(testing_group_names, html("SRank2")) ) .tab_header( title=html(f'

Euro NCAP SAFETY RATINGS - 2023

'), subtitle=html("

The more stars, the better.

"), ) .tab_spanner(a_html("Rating", explained), columns=["Stars", "Rank"]) ) for label, grp, grp_name in zip(spanners, testing_groups, testing_group_names): gtbl = gtbl.tab_spanner(label, columns=[*grp, grp_name]) source = 'Source: Euro NCAP' table = 'Table: Jerry Wu' repo = 'Repo: posit-gt-2024' ( gtbl.tab_stubhead(html('

')) .tab_options( stub_background_color=EuroNCAPPalette.STUB_COLUMN_LABEL.value, table_background_color=EuroNCAPPalette.TABLE_BACKGROUND.value, heading_align="left", heading_subtitle_font_size="16px", heading_subtitle_font_weight="bold", column_labels_font_size="14px", column_labels_background_color=EuroNCAPPalette.STUB_COLUMN_LABEL.value, row_group_font_size="18px", row_group_font_weight="bold", row_group_background_color=EuroNCAPPalette.ROW_GROUP.value, table_font_names=system_fonts("industrial"), ) .tab_style(style=style.fill(color=EuroNCAPPalette.CELL.value), locations=loc.body(columns=cs.all())) .tab_style( style=style.fill(color=EuroNCAPPalette.HIGHLIGHT1.value), locations=loc.body(columns="Stars", rows=pl.col("Stars").eq("5⭐")), ) .data_color( domain=[1, df.height], palette=[EuroNCAPPalette.GRADIENT1.value, EuroNCAPPalette.GRADIENT2.value, EuroNCAPPalette.GRADIENT3.value], columns=["Rank", *testing_group_names], ) .tab_source_note(html("1 Rank is derived from the rank of the averaged ranks across the four categories.")) .tab_source_note(html("2 SRank refers to ranking by the sum of each category.")) .tab_source_note(html("3 AEB C2C stands for AEB Car-to-Car.")) .tab_source_note(html(" | ".join([source, table, repo]))) )
